SELECT b.supplier_id,
    s.nombre AS supplier_nombre,
    s.ruc_clean,
    COALESCE(p.comitente_nombre, 'DESCONOCIDO'::text) AS comitente_nombre,
    COALESCE(p.categoria, 'OBRAS'::text) AS categoria,
    categorizar_tamano_contrato(COALESCE(p.monto_referencial, b.monto_ofertado)) AS size_bracket,
    count(b.id) AS total_participaciones,
    count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.gano = true OR b.estado_oferta = 'GANADORA'::text) AS total_ganadas,
        CASE
            WHEN count(b.id) > 0 THEN round(count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.gano = true OR b.estado_oferta = 'GANADORA'::text)::numeric / count(b.id)::numeric * 100::numeric, 1)
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS win_rate_pct,
    COALESCE(sum(b.monto_ofertado) FILTER (WHERE b.gano = true OR b.estado_oferta = 'GANADORA'::text), 0::numeric) AS total_monto_ganado,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN p.monto_referencial > 0::numeric AND b.monto_ofertado > 0::numeric THEN (p.monto_referencial - b.monto_ofertado) / p.monto_referencial * 100::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 2) AS avg_discount_pct,
    round(stddev_pop(
        CASE
            WHEN p.monto_referencial > 0::numeric AND b.monto_ofertado > 0::numeric THEN (p.monto_referencial - b.monto_ofertado) / p.monto_referencial * 100::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 2) AS stddev_discount_pct,
    count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE p.monto_referencial > 0::numeric AND b.monto_ofertado > 0::numeric) AS sample_size_with_price,
        CASE
            WHEN count(b.id) >= 15 THEN 'ALTA'::text
            WHEN count(b.id) >= 5 THEN 'MEDIA'::text
            WHEN count(b.id) >= 2 THEN 'BAJA'::text
            ELSE 'INSUFICIENTE'::text
        END AS certainty_tier
   FROM procurement_bids b
     JOIN procurement_suppliers s ON s.id = b.supplier_id
     JOIN procurement_processes p ON p.id = b.process_id
  GROUP BY b.supplier_id, s.nombre, s.ruc_clean, (COALESCE(p.comitente_nombre, 'DESCONOCIDO'::text)), (COALESCE(p.categoria, 'OBRAS'::text)), (categorizar_tamano_contrato(COALESCE(p.monto_referencial, b.monto_ofertado)));

SELECT s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.nombre,
    s.nombre_normalizado,
    s.ruc_clean,
    s.ruc_raw,
    s.dv,
    s.tipo_entidad,
    s.tamano,
    count(b.id) AS total_bids,
    count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.gano = true OR b.estado_oferta = 'GANADORA'::text) AS total_wins,
        CASE
            WHEN count(b.id) > 0 THEN round(count(b.id) FILTER (WHERE b.gano = true OR b.estado_oferta = 'GANADORA'::text)::numeric / count(b.id)::numeric * 100::numeric, 1)
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS global_win_rate_pct,
    COALESCE(sum(b.monto_ofertado) FILTER (WHERE b.gano = true OR b.estado_oferta = 'GANADORA'::text), 0::numeric) AS total_awarded_amount,
    round(avg(
        CASE
            WHEN p.monto_referencial > 0::numeric AND b.monto_ofertado > 0::numeric THEN (p.monto_referencial - b.monto_ofertado) / p.monto_referencial * 100::numeric
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END), 2) AS global_avg_discount_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN count(b.id) >= 15 THEN 'ALTA'::text
            WHEN count(b.id) >= 5 THEN 'MEDIA'::text
            WHEN count(b.id) >= 2 THEN 'BAJA'::text
            ELSE 'INSUFICIENTE'::text
        END AS certainty_tier,
    min(p.fecha_publicacion) AS first_seen_at,
    max(p.fecha_publicacion) AS last_seen_at
   FROM procurement_suppliers s
     LEFT JOIN procurement_bids b ON b.supplier_id = s.id
     LEFT JOIN procurement_processes p ON p.id = b.process_id
  GROUP BY s.id, s.nombre, s.nombre_normalizado, s.ruc_clean, s.ruc_raw, s.dv, s.tipo_entidad, s.tamano;
